trl_rationale: Flown on an actual mission; flight data and the successful landing confirm heatshield performance.

evidence.quote: The flight data from the instrumentation, along with the successful landing of the rover, confirms the performance of the heatshield and the conservative heatshield design and margins process.
The rover was protected from the extreme heating environments of Martian atmospheric entry by an ablative heatshield.
